title: At last, MutantMania
description: At last, MutantMania — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Go to MutantMania. Afterward, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Learning about MutantMania

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to MutantMania. Afterward, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

Have you heard about this MutantMania dungeon? Supposedly, it's got all sorts of underground fighting going on. Rule-breakers, ne'er-do-wells, and human punching bags pound the spit out of each other until they figure out which one is the best-of-the-best.

Sounds awesome, right? You should go check it out! Make your way to the Obelisk in the MutantMania Training Center. After that, scout around Level 1 and see what's what. Get back to me, the Townston Commander in Townston, when you're done. If you are turned into a human punching bag, leave behind any spit that gets pounded out of you.

Turn-in:

Tell me about MutantMania! Did you bring me back any action figures?

Objectives:

  • MutantMania Training Center
  • Explore MutantMania Level 1

Client level range: 80–100
